words: That's bedrock. Even you can't break it.
Break it. Build it. Make it yours.
Forests grow back, rivers carve new paths, seasons change the colours.
Team up with up to 8 friends against the tide golems.
Gears, pulleys and water wheels that actually turn.
Your world keeps running on our servers while you sleep.
A made-up game. The island is a real voxel world in WebGL.
A block island in 3D. Click a block to break it or build on it; drag to turn the island.
